title: Management Accountant Salary: Hourly Rates, Annual Pay, and Tax in Australia (2026–27)
description: Learn how to convert a management accountant salary from hourly to annual using 38-hour weeks, plus tax, super, and the National Minimum Wage. Use our timesheet tool.
salarySummary: Based on ABS average weekly earnings for full-time adults ($2,083.70 per week), a typical management accountant salary equates to approximately $54.83 per hour for a 38-hour week.

faqs.q: What is the typical hourly rate for a management accountant in Australia?
faqs.a: There is no single award rate for management accountants because the Clerks Award (MA000104) excludes professional accountants. The best benchmark is the Australian Bureau of Statistics' average weekly earnings for full-time adult ordinary time employees, which was $2,083.70 per week in May 2026. Dividing by 38 hours gives an hourly rate of about $54.83. Actual rates vary by experience, industry, and location.

faqs.q: How do I convert a management accountant salary from hourly to annual?
faqs.a: Use the formula: hourly rate × hours per week × 52. For a full-time management accountant working 38 hours per week, multiply the hourly rate by 38 then by 52. For example, $54.83 × 38 × 52 = $108,336 per year (before tax and super). Our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) page explains the calculation in more detail.

faqs.q: Is superannuation paid on top of a management accountant salary?
faqs.a: Yes. The superannuation guarantee requires employers to pay 12% of ordinary earnings on top of the base salary, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 (2026–27). For a management accountant earning $108,336, super would add about $13,000 per year. See our [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) page for more.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Management Accountant Salary in Australia

If you are looking at a **management accountant salary** — whether as an hourly rate or an annual package — it helps to know how the numbers stack up. Management accountants are professional employees, so they are generally not covered by modern awards. The Fair Work Commission’s Clerks Award, for example, specifically excludes “professional employees such as accountants.” That means your pay is set by your contract, enterprise agreement, or market rates.

### The National Minimum Wage as a Floor

Even though management accountants earn well above the minimum, it is useful to know the legal baseline. From 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for a 38‑hour week ([minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage)). Casual employees get a 25% loading on top, making the casual minimum $33.05 per hour. Most management accountant roles are permanent full‑time or part‑time, so the loading does not apply.

### Using ABS Average Weekly Earnings

The Australian Bureau of Statistics publishes Average Weekly Earnings (AWE) each May and November. For May 2026, full‑time adult ordinary time earnings were $2,083.70 per week. That figure includes all occupations, but it is a reasonable proxy for a professional role like management accounting. To find the equivalent hourly rate:

> **Hourly rate = weekly earnings ÷ 38 hours**

$2,083.70 ÷ 38 ≈ $54.83 per hour.

If you multiply that by 38 hours and 52 weeks, the annual salary is about $108,336. This is before tax and before super. Remember that AWE is an average; your actual management accountant salary could be higher or lower depending on your experience, industry, and location.

### Converting Hourly to Annual: The Formula

Whether you are negotiating a contract or checking an offer, the conversion is straightforward:

**Annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

For a full‑time management accountant working 38 hours per week, that is hourly × 38 × 52. If you work part‑time, use your actual weekly hours. Our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool can do the maths for you.

### Fortnightly Pay

Many employers pay fortnightly. To estimate your gross fortnightly pay, multiply your weekly pay by 2. For the average management accountant salary above, that would be $2,083.70 × 2 = $4,167.40 per fortnight.

### Tax and Medicare Levy

For the 2026–27 income year, the resident tax rates are:

- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15% of excess over $18,200
- $45,001 – $135,000: $4,020 + 30% of excess over $45,000
- $135,001 – $190,000: $31,020 + 37% of excess over $135,000
- $190,001+: $51,420 + 45% of excess over $190,000

Plus the Medicare levy of 2% (with reductions for low‑income singles and families). The tax‑free threshold means the first $18,200 is untaxed. For a management accountant earning $108,336, the tax (excluding Medicare) would be approximately $23,021, plus Medicare of about $2,167. Use our [take‑home pay](/topics/take-home) estimator for a personalised calculation.

### Superannuation Paid on Top

Superannuation guarantee contributions are 12% of ordinary earnings, paid by the employer on top of your salary. The maximum contribution base for 2026–27 is $270,830, so the full 12% applies to most management accountant salaries. For $108,336, super adds about $13,000 per year. This is not part of your take‑home pay but goes into your super fund. Learn more on our [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) page.

### Award Rates vs. Market Rates

While management accountants are not covered by the Clerks Award, other clerical and administrative roles are. The award sets minimum rates from Level 1 ($25.74 per hour) to Level 4 ($32.13 per hour) as of 1 July 2026. These rates are far below typical management accountant pay, which reflects the higher skill level and professional responsibilities. If you are comparing roles, always check whether an award applies or if the position is award‑free.

### Casual Loading for Temporary Roles

If a management accountant is engaged on a casual basis, they are entitled to a 25% loading on the base hourly rate. That means a casual management accountant earning $54.83 per hour would receive $68.54 per hour. However, casual loading is not paid on overtime. Our [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) page explains the rules.

### Using the Timesheet Tool

Our [timesheet](/) lets you enter your base hourly rate and optionally add the 25% casual loading. It then calculates your weekly, fortnightly, and annual gross pay, plus estimated tax and super. Remember: the tool assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, and no salary sacrifice. It is an estimate, not a binding determination.

### Summary

A management accountant salary in Australia is best benchmarked against ABS average weekly earnings. For a full‑time 38‑hour week, the average hourly rate is around $54.83, giving an annual gross of about $108,336. Tax and Medicare reduce that, and super adds about 12% on top. Use our [reference tables](/data) to explore different scenarios, and always check your contract for the exact terms.
